Hi Sam / Ayesha - great questions, writing up concrete answers below.

1) Control plane / air-gapped options
- Our Private offering supports two modes:
  - Connected control plane: the management/control plane remains reachable (TLS) to Redwood for telemetry/rollouts. This is the fastest to stand up and supports automatic updates.
  - Optional offline mode (air-gapped control plane): customers can run a self-hosted control plane entirely inside their VPC/on-prem. The inference runtime itself is fully self-contained and can operate without outbound connectivity if you provide a signed bundle and license keys.

2) KMS / BYOK
- We support AWS KMS integration for key wrapping, and we have integrations for customer-managed HSMs. BYOK is supported for Private: keys remain in your KMS and we operate with wrapped keys; we can provide an HSM-backed signing flow for offline installs.

3) Networking & tests we recommend
- Day 0: connectivity verification (NAT rules, DNS, port checks) if you opt for connected control plane
- Offline dry-run: air-gapped install using an install bundle (we'll run this with your infra team)
- Performance soak: 1 week running representative traffic; we'll provide a simple load script and sample prompts

I'll attach a short networking diagram and the runbook (PDFs attached). Proposed owners: Ayesha (Acme infra lead) + Aditya (Redwood SE) to coordinate.

Action items
- Ayesha: share a high-level network diagram + preferred dry-run week
- Sam: confirm whether procurement will require in-person security review or if SOC2 + vendor pack is sufficient initially
- Vanessa: I'll draft a short SOW template and test plan after we confirm dates
